title: Survey of 37 countries: the share of people who say social media is bad for democracy has risen significantly since 2022 or 2023; a median 55% say it's good (Pew Research Center)
summary: Pew Research Center: Survey of 37 countries: the share of people who say social media is bad for democracy has risen significantly since 2022 or 2023; a median 55% say it's good — Most think social media leads to manipulation and division, but they also say it informs people and gives them a voice in politics
